group.name: The Royal Botanic Garden | Sidney
group.description: The Royal Botanic Gardens, a state-supported botanical garden in Sydney, Australia, is the oldest such garden in the country. It occupies more than 27 hectares (66 acres) along the shores of Sydney Harbour, responsible for conservating a vast number of plants and it is known as one of the world's most biodiverse gardens, Within the garden, there is the Australian PlantBank, the largest native plant conservation seed bank in Australia. Housing over 100 million individual seeds in 10,000 seed collections, it has become one of the world’s most biodiverse seed banks.
